verdict.rationale: BugSnag is an error-monitoring/observability SaaS product with no evidenced AI agent or assistant feature that would consume external tools; the only MCP-related evidence shows BugSnag exposing its own MCP server for others to query (bugsnag-docs-21, bugsnag-probe-3), which is the opposite direction of 'plugging MCP servers into this product.' Since BugSnag has no agentic/tool-consuming interface, this axis is a category error rather than an unmet capability.
